newsitem.title: USA: Kerr-McGee names Luke Corbett chairman,CEO.
newsitem.headline: Kerr-McGee names Luke Corbett chairman,CEO.

text.p: Kerr-McGee Corp said Monday it has named Luke Corbett, 49, chairman and chief executive officer of the oil, gas and chemical company.
Corbett succeeds Frank McPherson, 63, who has retired after 14 years as chairman and chief executive.
Tom McDaniel, previously senior vice president and corporate secretary, was named vice chairman, the Oklahoma City-based company said.
Kerr-McGee's primary businesses are oil and natural exploration and production, speciality chemicals and coal.
The announcement of its change in leadership came after U.S. stock markets closed. Its stock was unchanged Monday at $68.75 on the New York Stock Exchange.
